## Bundled artwork (`Sources/MicroMapKit/Resources/FigmaAssets`)

Keycap textures, controller renders, and shortcut icons are derived from the
Figma Community file
[Work Louder x Figma](https://www.figma.com/community/file/1384624700163384062/work-louder-x-figma)
by **RobertCulver**, published under the
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
license. The artwork reproduces the printed keycap designs of the physical
Work Louder Figma Creator Micro device so that the on-screen preview matches
the real hardware.

CC BY 4.0 does not grant trademark rights. The Figma logo and wordmark are
trademarks of Figma, Inc. The Work Louder name and the Creator Micro product
design are the property of Work Louder. They are used here solely to identify
the physical device this application configures (nominative use).

## Interface icons

Some interface icons (cursor, back arrow) are by [Icons8](https://icons8.com),

## Trademarks and affiliation

This is an independent, community-made configurator. It is **not affiliated
with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Figma, Inc. or Work Louder**. Figma is a
trademark of Figma, Inc. Creator Micro is a product of Work Louder.

## Protocol acknowledgements

The app communicates with the device using the VIA configuration protocol
implemented by [QMK firmware](https://qmk.fm) and the [VIA](https://usevia.app)
project. The protocol support in this app is an independent reimplementation;
no QMK or VIA source code is included. Thanks to both projects for making
keyboards like the Creator Micro configurable in the first place.

## Shortcut data

`figma-shortcuts.json` is a transcription of Figma's publicly documented
keyboard shortcuts.
